title_en: Which Subway Seat Is Always Empty? 🩷 #shorts
description_en: Every Seoul subway car has pink seats for pregnant women. Even when the train is packed, many people leave them empty, just in case a mom-to-be gets on. That's 배려석 (baeryeoseok) — care seats. Stock footage: Pexels (free license)
hook_en: Which subway seat is always empty?
hook_vi: Ghế nào trên tàu điện luôn trống?
hook_id: Kursi kereta mana yang selalu kosong?
hook_es: ¿Qué asiento del metro siempre está vacío?
hook_pt: Qual assento do metrô está sempre vazio?
hook_ar: أي مقعد في المترو يبقى دائمًا فارغًا؟
hook_fil: Aling upuan sa subway ang laging walang tao?
hook_hi: मेट्रो की कौन-सी सीट हमेशा खाली रहती है?

hook_voice_parts.text: Which subway seat is always empty?

scenes.sub_en: Every Seoul subway car has pink seats for pregnant women: baeryeoseok — care seats.
scenes.sub_vi: Mỗi toa tàu điện Seoul có ghế màu hồng cho phụ nữ mang thai: "baeryeoseok" — ghế quan tâm.
scenes.sub_id: Setiap gerbong subway Seoul punya kursi pink untuk ibu hamil: "baeryeoseok" — kursi kepedulian.
scenes.sub_es: Cada vagón del metro de Seúl tiene asientos rosas para embarazadas: «baeryeoseok», asientos de cuidado.
scenes.sub_pt: Cada vagão do metrô de Seul tem assentos cor-de-rosa para gestantes: "baeryeoseok", assentos de cuidado.
scenes.sub_ar: كل عربة مترو في سيول فيها مقاعد وردية للحوامل: "باريوسوك" — مقاعد الرعاية.
scenes.sub_fil: Bawat bagon ng subway sa Seoul may pink na upuan para sa buntis: "baeryeoseok" — care seats.
scenes.sub_hi: सियोल मेट्रो के हर डिब्बे में गर्भवती महिलाओं के लिए गुलाबी सीटें हैं: "बारेयोसॉक" — केयर सीट्स।

voice_parts.text: Every Seoul subway car has pink seats for pregnant women.

scenes.sub_en: Even when the train is packed, many people leave them empty — just in case a mom-to-be gets on.
scenes.sub_vi: Kể cả khi tàu đông, nhiều người vẫn để trống — phòng khi có mẹ bầu lên.
scenes.sub_id: Bahkan saat kereta penuh, banyak orang membiarkannya kosong — kalau-kalau ada ibu hamil naik.
scenes.sub_es: Aun con el tren lleno, muchos las dejan libres por si sube una futura mamá.
scenes.sub_pt: Mesmo com o trem cheio, muitos deixam vazios, caso uma gestante entre.
scenes.sub_ar: حتى في القطار المزدحم، يتركها كثيرون فارغة — احتياطًا لامرأة حامل.
scenes.sub_fil: Kahit puno ang tren, marami ang nag-iiwan nito — baka sakaling may buntis na sumakay.
scenes.sub_hi: भीड़ भरी ट्रेन में भी कई लोग इन्हें खाली छोड़ देते हैं — कहीं कोई गर्भवती चढ़ जाए।

voice_parts.text: Even when the train is packed, many people leave them empty — just in case a mom-to-be gets on.

cta.en: Not a rule. Just care. Would you leave it empty? Yes or no?
cta.like: Like if you'd leave it empty 👇
cta.sub_en: It's not a rule you get fined for. It's care. Would you leave it empty? Yes or no?
cta.sub_vi: Không phải luật bị phạt. Đó là sự quan tâm. Bạn có để trống không? Có hay không?
cta.sub_id: Bukan aturan yang ada dendanya. Ini kepedulian. Mau kamu biarkan kosong? Iya atau tidak?
cta.sub_es: No es una norma con multa. Es cuidado. ¿La dejarías libre? ¿Sí o no?
cta.sub_pt: Não é regra com multa. É cuidado. Você deixaria vazio? Sim ou não?
cta.sub_ar: ليس قانونًا بغرامة. إنه اهتمام. هل ستتركه فارغًا؟ نعم أم لا؟
cta.sub_fil: Hindi ito batas na may multa. Malasakit ito. Iiwan mo bang walang tao? Oo o hindi?
cta.sub_hi: यह जुर्माने वाला नियम नहीं है। यह परवाह है। क्या आप इसे खाली छोड़ेंगे? हाँ या नहीं?

voice_parts.text: It's not a rule you get fined for. It's care. Would you leave it empty? Yes or no?
